entities.summary: Lieutenant-General Sir Herbert Taylor Macpherson was a British Army and Indian Army officer and a Scottish recipient of the Victoria Cross, the highest and most prestigious award for gallantry in the face of the enemy that can be awarded to British and Commonwealth forces.
